session_summary: A patient visited a doctor for persistent cough, fever, and fatigue. The doctor prescribed medication, recommended tests, and issued a medical leave. The patient was advised to quit smoking and attend a cessation program.

proposed_actions.title: Schedule Chest X-ray
proposed_actions.description: Get a chest X-ray done at the county hospital radiology department.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I want a chest X-ray today or at the latest tomorrow.

proposed_actions.title: Take Medication
proposed_actions.description: Take amoxicillin with clavulanic acid, 1000 milligrams, twice a day for 7 days.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I'll prescribe amoxicillin with clavulanic acid, 1000 milligrams, twice a day for 7 days.

proposed_actions.title: Take Paracetamol for Fever
proposed_actions.description: Take paracetamol for fever, no more than 4 tablets a day.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: For the fever take paracetamol, no more than 4 tablets a day.

proposed_actions.title: Get Medical Leave Certificate
proposed_actions.description: Collect the medical leave certificate from the doctor and take it to human resources.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I'll issue the medical leave certificate now, you take it to human resources.

proposed_actions.title: Perform Blood Tests
proposed_actions.description: Do a complete blood count and C-reactive protein test tomorrow morning on an empty stomach.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: Do a complete blood count and C-reactive protein test, tomorrow morning, on an empty stomach.

proposed_actions.title: Attend Follow-up Appointment
proposed_actions.description: Come back on Tuesday, November 10th, at 8:30, with the X-ray and test results.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I'll be waiting on Tuesday, November 10th, at 8:30, with the X-ray and test results.

proposed_actions.title: Attend Smoking Cessation Program
proposed_actions.description: Register for the smoking cessation program at the clinic and attend the sessions.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I recommend the smoking cessation program at the clinic.

decisions: The patient will be given a medical leave of 5 days, up to Tuesday inclusive.
risks: If the fever goes above 39 or the patient has trouble breathing, they should come immediately or call the emergency department.
follow_up_questions: When will the smoking cessation program start?
